Nidalee|jgl.identity: Two-form magic damage huntress who specializes in fast clearing and poke. In human form: Javelin Toss (Q) deals more damage the farther it travels and marks the target (Hunted), Bushwhack (W) places a trap, and Primal Surge (E) heals an ally and boosts their attack speed. In cougar form: Takedown (Q) executes wounded targets, Pounce (W) leaps farther onto a Hunted target, and Swipe (E) strikes in a cone. Aspect of the Cougar (R) switches forms from level 1.
Nidalee|jgl.playstyle: Tempo jungler: very fast clear, invades, javelin poke and dives on marked targets. A missed javelin sharply reduces your options.
Nidalee|jgl.early_game: Clear fast by alternating forms (javelin on the camp to mark it, then cougar form). Invade when you can: you're one of the fastest junglers at stealing camps. Poke lanes with the javelin before ganking, and heal your laners with human E.
Nidalee|jgl.level_2: Primal Surge / Swipe (E). Healing in human form, big cone damage in cougar form: your clear speeds up.
Nidalee|jgl.level_3: Bushwhack / Pounce (W). First gank: javelin to mark → long Pounce onto the Hunted target → Swipe → Takedown to finish.
Nidalee|jgl.level_6: Your transformation ranks up at level 6 (stronger cougar abilities). Your dives on marked targets become very dangerous, especially in skirmishes.
power_spikes: First completed item: javelins that take a big chunk of health.
Two items: dominant poke before objectives.
Mid game: picks on marked targets.
Nidalee|jgl.jungle_plan: Very fast clear and invades. Nidalee wins through tempo: steal enemy camps, control Scuttles and poke before Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. Place traps (human W) in bushes and jungle entrances for vision. Gank lanes where your javelin can land.
Nidalee|jgl.trading: Ganking: javelin (mark) → Pounce → Swipe → Takedown. Skirmishing: poke with the javelin before engaging, then dive on the marked target. Give up on it if your javelin missed and the target isn't low.
threats: Tanks who soak your poke (Rammus, Zac, Nunu & Willump).
Fiddlesticks and Evelynn, who catch you by surprise.
mistakes: Missing the javelin and diving anyway.
Forgetting to heal your laners with human E.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: You farm faster: steal his camps and poke him.
matchup_notes.Graves: Poke him before he sticks to you; steal his camps when he's far away.
matchup_notes.Viego: Poke him with the javelin before fights.
matchup_notes.Rammus: His armor cancels your poke and his taunt locks you down: avoid him.
matchup_notes.Fiddlesticks: Place traps in bushes to spot his ambushes.

Nidalee|jgl.mid_game: Poke and picks before objectives. Turn your tempo into dragons and towers.
Nidalee|jgl.late_game: Poke with the javelin, then dive on marked, low targets. Stay back until your javelin has landed.
Nidalee|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler, take objectives and poke before every fight.
Nidalee|jgl.behind: Farm, poke safely and look for picks on marked targets.
Nidalee|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to set the tempo through farming and invades, then poke and execute marked targets.
Nidalee|jgl.final_tip: Throw your javelin from far away: the farther it travels, the more damage it deals.
